scope: User authorized next candidate after F01/F04; take F06 as stated before work. Retrospective offline screen on192 immutable existing snapshots; no environment rollout or persistent learner update. Historical outcomes already seen: exploratory, not new confirmation.
panel_definition: Use verified complete500-step episodes and the same time-stratified, episode-disjoint M/A sampling as F05/F04. These are previously seen replay. No fresh generalization data. Four tasks equally weighted, irrespective of allocation label.

static.layers: Actor final latent_pi post-ReLU; each critic final hidden post-ReLU at stored replay actions. Require unshared feature extractors, no SDE/dropout/batchnorm.
static.dormancy: Per-neuron mean absolute activation divided by layer mean absolute activation; fraction<=0.01 primary, thresholds0 and0.1 fixed sensitivities. All-zero layer explicitly flagged, dormant fraction1 and effective rank0.
static.rank: Uncentered activation matrix squared singular values normalized to sum1; exp(entropy)/min(samples,width). Compute Gram in float64; clamp negative roundoff eigenvalues. Audit by direct SVD on fixed representative snapshots.
static.aggregation: Mean across4 tasks; mean twin critics; actor and combined critic equally weighted. Two primary static features: dormant fraction and normalized effective rank. No neuron/threshold fishing.

coverage_controls: Exclude4 task one-hot dimensions. Per-task raw observation centered RMS Euclidean spread and centered effective rank normalized by dimension; log1p spread and rank averaged across tasks. Unscaled physical-coordinate proxies, NOT success experience/goal relevance and not full F03 validation.

dynamic.batch_plan: 64 transitions per task,8 from each of8 age strata. Seeded permutation within stratum,16 disjoint batches cover panel; iterations17to20 revisit first4. Same planned batches for actor/critic. Panels reversed for audit.
dynamic.actor: Deep-copy actor and its exact Adam state. Optimize SAC actor objective against separately copied frozen current critics and fixed alpha. One fixed standard-normal draw per state, same draw at steps0/1/20. Critic parameters are not updated in actor diagnostic.
dynamic.critic: Deep-copy both critics and exact Adam state. Optimize mean twin squared residual using fixed soft targets from the original actor/target critics,4 action draws per transition, timeout bootstrap preserved. Targets never recomputed during updates.
dynamic.evaluation: At steps0,1,20 evaluate each task on BOTH full panels. Keep training-panel and other-panel loss changes separate. Record loss mean and RMS before/after. Normalize changes by step0 per-transition loss RMS floored1e-6, average equally over tasks.
dynamic.primary_features: Two other-panel additional improvements (loss_step1-loss_step20)/RMS_step0, one actor and one critic. Baseline already contains actual one-step other-panel improvements. This asks about continued fitting beyond the first update, not pure neural plasticity or success gradients.
dynamic.audit: Independent reset of clone from original snapshot, train A/evaluate M with separate fixed noise. Matched one-step audit baseline. No diagnostic updates are saved as training checkpoints.
dynamic.cost: 2 train panels x2 optimizer modules x20=80 clone optimizer steps per snapshot,15360 main steps. No entropy coefficient or target-network diagnostic update. Count all clone steps separately from persistent learner updates.

base: Full F01 marginal profile (focus/cp400,4p0,4delta,4positive declines), F05 log1p reward/target scales and normalized residual/twin gap, raw-state spread/rank controls; primary adds measured one-step actor/critic loss change. No task/seed/suite identity or future input.
prediction: 20k input predicts same-branch D40-D20; F07 outcome-independent hash D50/O50, old data exploratory. Leave out original seed across all suites/checkpoints. Weighted mean-loss ridge penalty1, fold-only standardization, intercept unpenalized, no tuning. A/B/C equal; A200/A400 half within A; seeds/repeats equal.
selection: Primary same-repeat choose among5 actual20k probes, score SAME actual chosen40k O continuation. Secondary average other2 repeats20k scores, score held third40k. Uniform/Failure/Greedy20/development-fixed(other original seeds D40) controls. Tie Uniform then task order tol1e-12.
uncertainty: Joint O-case bootstrap, all policies/fits/diagnostic cases/choices fixed. Does not include training, fitting or selection uncertainty. No population significance from3 original seed blocks.
screen: Primary mean additional choice gain>=1pp, >=2 positive original seed blocks, no group below-2pp; also inspect strong controls/audit. Static and total20 comparisons are predefined secondary screens, not substitutes for primary. No final promotion without new-seed and cost-inclusive validation.
costs: Actual new environment/persistent learner steps0; record clone optimizer steps, wall/CPU/CUDA event intervals. Historical same-repeat probes100k+selected20k=120k training, cross-repeat200k+independent40k=240k plus parent/probe evaluation. F05 features reused, deployment remeasurement cost not rebenchmarked. No online40k budget claim.
verification: Reconstruct every static feature from stored neuron means/eigenvalues and every dynamic feature from per-task losses. Verify0/1/20 using independently implemented objectives and gradient extraction on earliest parent/focus of each suite/checkpoint group; direct SVD checks; zero-learning-rate control. Reconstruct predictions/choices with augmented least squares. Preserve failed attempts and immutable source snapshots.
